❌ Legacy SDP Dependency & Lip-Sync Failure Modes (RFC 5583 / 5888)
1. a=depend Circular Dependency Deadlock: Cyclic lay/mdc declarations
(L1:98 -> L2:99 -> L1:98) or dangling mid:PT targets hang decoder queues.
2. Video-Induced Voice Playout Stall: Under a=group:LS, a lost video
keyframe awaiting 380ms NACK retransmission blocks 0%-loss Opus audio.
3. Unbounded Playout Buffer Inflation: Holding audio for stalled video
destroys sub-500ms conversational turn-taking and barge-in responsiveness.
Result: Decoder dependency deadlock + 380ms+ voice playout stalls
✅ Deterministic P1003–P1004 🎉 (Stage 505 & Topic 145!) Gate
1. P1003 🎉 (🎉 Stage 505!) Acyclic DAG & [1,4] Depth Lock: Reject cyclic
or dangling a=depend graphs (SIP 488) & clamp dependency depth ∈ [1, 4].
2. P1004 🎉 (🎉 Topic 145!) [20, 80]ms Audio Hold Ceiling: Cap a=group:LS
audio wait time in [20, 80]ms & decouple voice immediately when exceeded.
3. Silence-Boundary Resync: Smoothly re-align A/V lip-sync during
inter-talkspurt silence without pitch-warping active caller/agent speech.
Result: 0 dependency cycles · 0 voice playout stalls · hold ∈ [20, 80]ms
